lines.text: Give a bit of money to share.
Let's all chip in for her gift.

data.mean: Give a bit of money to share.
data.define: To give some money so a group can buy something.

example.text: Let's all chip in for her gift.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chip in' about potato chips.

data.l1_hook: Hadiah untuk dia? Ada yang mau "chip in"?
data.l1_ex: Ayo semua chip in untuk hadiah dia.

native.tip: “chip in” = menyumbang. Contoh: “Let's all chip in for her gift.”
